newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's BTC surges in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's BTC surges in early trade.

text.p: Slovenian shopping centre operator BTC surged 4.11 percent within minutes of the bourse's opening on Wednesday following news the company's GDR issue was six times oversubscribed.
By 0743 GMT BTC was up 580 tolars to 14,700 tolars on volume of 110 shares.
But traders feel the share may soon face resistance.

"I do not think BTC could rise above 15,000 tolars because there will be no arbitrage between the London and Ljubljana bourse therefore the GDR price will not have a direct affect on BTC share price in Ljubljana," said Mateja Gubanec, a trader of bank A banka. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
